description: Land Acquisition - Magamure, Kamburupitiya In Matara District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the compulsory acquisition of specific land parcels for a public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of the land (including lot numbers, names, descriptions, extents, and claimants' information), which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land acquisitions and related administrative procedures.
